pages.text: A normal nicotine draw restores two points of saturation. A cigar restores four per draw, capped by your current food level. Cigars have three draws and cigarettes have one.

pages.title: Brief Effect
pages.text: The profile clears quickly and adds a mild color effect. You can also use $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/smoking_tools)dried tobacco in smoking tools$(/l). Peyote joints carry a small tobacco component.
